newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's LE CARTON firm turnover up to $3.7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's LE CARTON firm turnover up to $3.7 mln.

text.p: Morocco's wrapping paper firm, LE CARTON, showed on Monday a slight rise to 32.6 million dirhams ($3.7 million) in its first half turnover from 31 million dirhams ($3.6 million) in the same period last year.
One of the 46 listed stocks on the Casablanca bourse, LE CARTON, registered a 0.12 million dirham loss in the first half of the year but gave no comparative figure for the same period in 1995.
The company made a net profit of 0.2 million dirhams in the whole year of 1995, it said.
Established in Casablanca in 1927, LE CARTON has a capital of 5.7 million dirhams and a staff of 300. Its production capacity is estimated at 4,000 tonnes per year.
It was last traded at 170 dirhams per share, stockbrokers said.
The firm has no identification code on the Casablanca stock exchange yet.
